extraction.Name: Mary Dillon (widow of William McClosky or Dillon, Dec'd)
extraction.Occupation/Income: I support them with trust funds and raise garden chickens and so forth
extraction.NOTES: Document is fragmentary — only partial pages visible. Husband is William McClosky or Dillon, deceased. Has two surviving children; two girls died since husband's death. Obtained credit at a store in Colome (name unknown), husband would go get the things. States she is not in good health. States 'I think we did not get enough money for this land and want the Government to look into it and see if there is some way to help me.' Subscribed and sworn before notary public June 5, 1929; notary commission expires 4-28-32. | TASK 5 CAT_3 BACKFILL 2026-05-04 (patents database): Allotment 481, tribe Rosebud Sioux, sourced from federal-register-app patents database (Christian's research). CAT_3 record — Sonnet text extraction captured the allottee Name but not the Allotment number. CROSS-REFERENCE: Same Mary Dillon as part7_affidavit_005. Both records are the same person, allotment 481. McCloskey connects to the Whipple-related Rosebud family.
